QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer covers scope resolution and lists unindexed file types in a `not_indexed` report. It never says that a file within scope reaches the index only if something can read it. It does not name the parse-built front end for types doxygen cannot read, or binary classification of files whose extensions lie, and it admits it didn't establish which extensions the parser accepts.
